description: Fetch and index a GitHub repository so it can be taught and interviewed. Call this FIRST whenever the user provides a repo URL or asks to prep a repo that has not been ingested yet. Builds a code map (sections in a suggested teaching order) and caches file contents locally. Returns the repo summary and the first few sections — NOT full code; use get_code_section to pull code. Safe to call again on the same repo: it refreshes the code while preserving the user's progress and weakness history.

branch.description: Branch to ingest; defaults to the repo's default branch

repo_url.description: GitHub repo URL (https://github.com/owner/repo) or shorthand owner/repo

name: ingest_repo
title: Ingest Repository
